summary: Iteration 29: Tested 5 major new features - Client Health Score Engine, Contract Renewal Alerts with SLA Tiers, Project Milestones, Client Activity Timeline, and Global Notification Bell. All 21 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified working. Fixed 2 backend bugs during testing: 1) Added missing sla_tier field to Contract model, 2) Fixed datetime timezone comparison error in renewal-alerts endpoint.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 29 added 5 major features: 1) Client Health Score Engine calculates 0-100 score based on tickets/30 + sla/20 + devices/20 + payments/20 + contracts/10. Risk levels: healthy>=75, attention>=50, at_risk>=25, critical<25. Visible in Clients list and detail view. 2) Contracts have SLA tiers (platinum/gold/silver/standard), renewal alerts show within 90 days with urgency colors. 3) Projects support milestones via API (POST/GET /api/projects/{id}/milestones) and time-summary endpoint. 4) Client detail has Timeline tab combining tickets/invoices/time entries. 5) NotificationBell component in Sidebar shows unread count, dropdown with device_offline, sla_breach, contract_renewal notifications. All backend APIs work with 21/21 tests passing.
seed_data_creation: Created test project (TEST_Milestone_Test_Project) and test contract (TEST_SLA_Tier_Contract) during testing. The contract with SLA tier was deleted after verification. The test project remains for future testing.
